regions.today: A little cool this morning with a chilly northerly breeze. A mix of cloud and sunshine today generally but a few isolated showers will drift down over the province too. A little windy at times with highest temperatures of 12 to 14 degrees.
regions.tonight: Any showers will gradually clear away as northerly winds ease and plenty of clear spells develop. Lowest temperatures of 3 of 6 degrees but feeling rather cool in the breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Cloudy overall and perhaps more unsettled with a mix of scattered showers and isolated sunny spells. Some of the showers may be a little heavy at times too. Feeling cool in the northerly breeze with highest temperatures of 9 to 14 degrees.
